title: DeLonge already had ten advisers by November 2014

tellings.quote: But Peter Levenda, who was someone who worked closely with DeLonge, he said by the time he joined, which was November 2014, there were already 10 advisers.

plain: By November 2014, the musician Tom DeLonge is said to have already gathered ten advisers for his effort to get the UFO story out. The researcher Jason Simosa says he got this from the author Peter Levenda, who worked closely with DeLonge and said there were already ten advisers when he joined that month. It matters because it would show DeLonge's network of insiders was built well before it went public.
